# CIVILIAN GUIDANCE [italic]Read this once. Keep it in mind every shift.[/italic]
The garrison is here to keep the colony, its people and its works intact. On a quiet day you will see a patrol walk past the mess and nothing more. When command raises the alert state, the rules below apply to everyone, staff and visitor alike.
## AT A CHECKPOINT - Stop when told to stop. Keep your hands where the sentry can see them. - Have your colony ID ready. Contractors also show a current work order. - Declare any firearm before you are searched. Weapons without a Colonial Marshal licence are confiscated and logged. - Do not photograph or record checkpoints, sentry posts or troop movements.
## CURFEW - Curfew hours are posted on this board and called over the colony PA. - Movement after curfew needs a pass from Colony Administration or the garrison duty officer. Essential workers keep theirs on their person.
## WHEN THE SIREN SOUNDS - Get indoors and away from windows. Stay there until the all clear. - Follow your block warden. Do not come to the garrison gate; it will be closed. - Shelter locations are listed by [netlink="Colony Administration" link="admin.colony.gov"].
## WHAT TO REPORT - Unattended bags, crates or vehicles. - Strangers asking about patrol times, the armoury or the landing pad. - Cut fences, broken locks, missing explosives or mining charges. - A gas alarm sounding, or a gas monitor that is dark, damaged or tampered with. Carbon monoxide has no smell; the monitor is your nose.
The garrison does not ask about your politics. It asks that you do not carry a rifle for anyone.
## WHAT THE GARRISON DOES NOT DO Troops do not collect debts, settle disputes between neighbours or enforce Company contracts. Take those to the Marshals or to Administration. A complaint about a soldier goes in writing to the executive officer. Every complaint is logged and answered.
